# QuickSolve Platinum

> QuickSolve Platinum is a client-side calculator platform containing 70+ calculators across finance, health, programming, science, mathematics, time, age, units, discounts, GST, currency and data visualization.

## Website

- Home: https://quicksolve-platinum.netlify.app/
- Scientific Calculator: https://quicksolve-platinum.netlify.app/scientific_suite/scientific.html
- Programmer Toolkit: https://quicksolve-platinum.netlify.app/programmer.html
- Graph & Visualization: https://quicksolve-platinum.netlify.app/graph.html
- Currency Suite: https://quicksolve-platinum.netlify.app/currency.html
- Health Suite: https://quicksolve-platinum.netlify.app/health.html
- Loan & EMI Suite: https://quicksolve-platinum.netlify.app/loan.html
- GST Suite: https://quicksolve-platinum.netlify.app/gst.html
- Age Suite: https://quicksolve-platinum.netlify.app/age.html
- Unit Converter: https://quicksolve-platinum.netlify.app/unit.html
- Time Suite: https://quicksolve-platinum.netlify.app/time.html
- Percentage Suite: https://quicksolve-platinum.netlify.app/percentage.html
- Discount Suite: https://quicksolve-platinum.netlify.app/discount.html

## Technical Information

QuickSolve is primarily a static, client-side web application.

Calculator computations are performed in the browser using JavaScript. The project contains shared calculation utilities and suite-specific calculator logic.

QuickSolve does not expose a QuickSolve-owned backend API, database, authentication system, or server-side calculator API.

The Currency suite may make user-triggered requests to external currency-data services for current exchange-rate information.

## Important Notes

- Calculator results should be treated as computational outputs from the corresponding calculator and its inputs.
- Health calculators are informational tools and are not a substitute for professional medical advice.
- Financial and tax calculations are informational and should be verified against applicable official rules, rates, and terms when used for real-world decisions.
- Currency results may depend on external exchange-rate data and its update time.
